              | CAtom(String)

   # An Erlang abstract form (the operator is carried as a string — see moduledoc):
   #   FInt  -> {integer, _, N}     FVar -> {var, _, Name}   FAtom -> {atom, _, A}
   #   FUn   -> {op, _, Op, Arg}    FBin -> {op, _, Op, L, R}
+  #   FCall -> {call, _, {atom, _, F}, Args}  (a local function call)
   type Form := FInt(String)
              | FVar(String)
              | FAtom(String)
              | FUn(String, Form)
              | FBin(String, Form, Form)
+             | FCall(String, Vec(Form))
 
   # Rian binary operator -> Erlang operator spelling (the reference `erl_op`).
   def eop(String) String
@@ -62,4 +65,14 @@ mod SelfhostBeam do
   pub def emit(CAtom(a)) := FAtom(a)
   pub def emit(CUnary(op, x)) := FUn(uop(op), emit(x))
   pub def emit(CBin(op, l, r)) := FBin(eop(op), emit(l), emit(r))
+  # a local function call `f(args)` -> {call, _, {atom, _, f}, [arg forms]} (the
+  # reference's lowercase-`ECall` branch); the callee name rides as a string, the
+  # fixpoint inflating it to the `{atom, _, f}` head. PascalCase ctor-as-tuple is
+  # the `:partial` tail.
+  pub def emit(CCall(f, args)) := FCall(f, forms_of(args))
+
+  # map `emit` over an argument vector (no FFI — a recursive fold to `Vec(Form)`).
+  def forms_of(Vec(Core)) Vec(Form)
+  def forms_of([]) := []
+  def forms_of([x | rest]) := [emit(x) | forms_of(rest)]
 end

@@ -53,4 +54,13 @@ mod SelfhostJs do
   pub def emit(CAtom(a)) := dq(a)
   pub def emit(CUnary(op, x)) := unop(op) <> emit(x)
   pub def emit(CBin(op, l, r)) := "(" <> emit(l) <> " " <> jsop(op) <> " " <> emit(r) <> ")"
+  # a function call `f(a, b)` -> `f(a, b)` (the reference's general `ECall` shape);
+  # variant construction `Ctor(…)` and labelled-arg structs are the `:partial` tail.
+  pub def emit(CCall(f, args)) := f <> "(" <> emit_args(args) <> ")"
+
+  # comma-join the emitted argument expressions (no FFI — a recursive fold).
+  def emit_args(Vec(Core)) String
+  def emit_args([]) := ""
+  def emit_args([x]) := emit(x)
+  def emit_args([x | rest]) := emit(x) <> ", " <> emit_args(rest)
 end

@@ -85,6 +86,9 @@ mod SelfhostRust do
   pub def emit(CId(n)) := Em(s: n, pr: 12)
   pub def emit(CUnary(op, x)) := Em(s: udisp(op) <> paren(emit(x), 11), pr: 11)
   pub def emit(CBin(op, l, r)) := bin_em(op, l, r)
+  # a call `f(a, b)` binds tightest (prec 12, like a leaf); each argument is a full
+  # expression rendered at context 0 (comma-self-delimited, never parenthesised).
+  pub def emit(CCall(f, args)) := Em(s: f <> "(" <> args_str(args) <> ")", pr: 12)
 
   # Left/right context precedences come from associativity; assemble the binary.
   def bin_em(op String, l Core, r Core) Em
@@ -99,6 +103,12 @@ mod SelfhostRust do
     Em(s: paren(emit(l), lc) <> " " <> disp(op) <> " " <> paren(emit(r), rc), pr: prec(op))

+  # comma-join the rendered arguments (context 0 — an argument never needs parens).
+  def args_str(Vec(Core)) String
+  def args_str([]) := ""
+  def args_str([x]) := paren(emit(x), 0)
+  def args_str([x | rest]) := paren(emit(x), 0) <> ", " <> args_str(rest)
+
   # The rendered Rust expression string.
   pub def render(c Core) String
     e := emit(c)

     end
+
+    test "a call binds tightest and its args take no parens", %{mod: mod} do
